   361	Zariski-separated on these binders. Take the non-representability directly; see
   362	the module docstring.) Against `picEt` it is Kleiman's own
   363	theorem. `PicScheme.picEt_isSheaf_forget` records the sheaf property that makes
   364	the difference, and it is proved rather than assumed.
   365	
   366	**Expected to stay open, and that is the honest state rather than a defect.**
   367	The project reaches this statement rather than proving it, and it is the single
   368	named `sorry` that the whole Jacobian headline rests on. Do not replace it with
   369	a weaker conditional statement to make a count go down.
   370	
   371	**Which route THIS PROJECT takes — and the 2026-07-29 version of this paragraph
   372	overstated, corrected 2026-07-30 (`review-ajc`, by reading Kleiman rather than
   373	the board).** That version said the previous text "named the inputs of a route
   374	this project does not take", listing `Div` representability (Kleiman §3 Thm
   375	`th:repDiv`) and the Altman–Kleiman quotient lemma `smoothProperQuotient`, and
   376	concluded the prescription was *simply wrong* because both belong to the
   377	Grothendieck/Kleiman quotient route, `rejected` on the board
   378	(`AJC.picrep.quot`, `AJC.picrep.serre`).
   379	
   380	**Right about which route AJC CHOSE; wrong as a statement about what discharging
   381	this `sorry` NEEDS.** Read from the source
   382	(`references/kleiman-picard-src/kleiman-picard.tex`): `th:main` L2155–L2166 is
   383	clause (1)'s **conclusion** verbatim — "Assume `f : X → S` is projective Zariski
   384	locally over `S`, and is flat with integral geometric fibers. (1) Then
   385	`Pic_{X/S}` exists, is separated and locally of finite type over `S`, and
   386	represents `Pic_{(X/S)ét}`" — with no rational-point hypothesis. And Kleiman's
   387	proof reduces (1) to (2) and then runs exactly the two named inputs: the Abel map

/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
MEASURED_HEAD=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
SHORT=$(env -u GIT_INDEX_FILE "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --shortstat "$MEASURED_HEAD")
NAME_STATUS=$(env -u GIT_INDEX_FILE "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-status "$MEASURED_HEAD")
printf '"'MEASURED_HEAD %s\\n' \""'$MEASURED_HEAD"
printf '"'SHORTSTAT %s\\n' \""'$SHORT"
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$NAME_STATUS"
TOTAL=0
D_COUNT=0
D_LEAN=0
M_COUNT=0
A_COUNT=0
AT_RISK=0
while IFS=$'"'\\t' read -r status path rest
do
  test -n \""'${status:-}" || continue
  TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))
  case "$status" in
    D)
      D_COUNT=$((D_COUNT + 1))
      case "$path" in *.lean) D_LEAN=$((D_LEAN + 1));; esac
      HEAD_OK=0
      DISK_OK=0
      if "$HORIZON_GIT" cat-file -e "$MEASURED_HEAD:$path" 2>/dev/null
      then HEAD_OK=1
      fi
      if test -e "$path"
      then DISK_OK=1
      fi
      if test "$HEAD_OK" -ne 1 || test "$DISK_OK" -ne 1
      then
        AT_RISK=$((AT_RISK + 1))
        printf '"'AT_RISK status=%s head=%s disk=%s path=%s\\n' \""'$status" "$HEAD_OK" "$DISK_OK" "$path"
      fi
      ;;
    M*) M_COUNT=$((M_COUNT + 1));;
    A*) A_COUNT=$((A_COUNT + 1));;
  esac
done <<< "$NAME_STATUS"
printf '"'COUNTS total=%d modified=%d added=%d deleted=%d deleted_lean=%d at_risk=%d\\n' \""'$TOTAL" "$M_COUNT" "$A_COUNT" "$D_COUNT" "$D_LEAN" "$AT_RISK"'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
MEASURED_HEAD=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
SHORT=$(env -u GIT_INDEX_FILE "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --shortstat "$MEASURED_HEAD")
NAME_STATUS=$(env -u GIT_INDEX_FILE "$HORIZON_GIT" -c diff.renameLimit=20000 diff --cached --name-status "$MEASURED_HEAD")
TOTAL=$(awk '"'NF {n++} END {print n+0}' <<< \""'$NAME_STATUS")
M_COUNT=$(awk -F'"'\\t' '"'$1 ~ /''^M/ {n++} END {print n+0}'"' <<< \""'$NAME_STATUS")
A_COUNT=$(awk -F'"'\\t' '"'$1 ~ /''^A/ {n++} END {print n+0}'"' <<< \""'$NAME_STATUS")
D_COUNT=$(awk -F'"'\\t' '"'$1 == "D" {n++} END {print n+0}'"' <<< \""'$NAME_STATUS")
D_LEAN=$(awk -F'"'\\t' '"'$1 == "D" && $2 ~ /[.]lean$/ {n++} END {print n+0}'"' <<< \""'$NAME_STATUS")
HEAD_BATCH=$(awk -F'"'\\t' -v h=\""'$MEASURED_HEAD" '"'"'$1 == "D" {print h ":" $2}'"' <<< \""'$NAME_STATUS" | "$HORIZON_GIT" cat-file --batch-check)
HEAD_MISSING=$(awk '"'"'$2 == "missing" {n++} END {print n+0}'"' <<< \""'$HEAD_BATCH")
DISK_MISSING=0
DISK_MISSING_LEAN=0
while IFS=$'"'\\t' read -r status path rest
do
  if test \""'${status:-}" = D && ! test -e "$path"
  then
    DISK_MISSING=$((DISK_MISSING + 1))
    case "$path" in *.lean) DISK_MISSING_LEAN=$((DISK_MISSING_LEAN + 1));; esac
    printf '"'DISK_MISSING %s\\n' \""'$path"
  fi
done <<< "$NAME_STATUS"
printf '"'MEASURED_HEAD %s\\n' \""'$MEASURED_HEAD"
printf '"'SHORTSTAT %s\\n' \""'$SHORT"
printf '"'COUNTS total=%d modified=%d added=%d deleted=%d deleted_lean=%d head_missing=%d disk_missing=%d disk_missing_lean=%d\\n' \""'$TOTAL" "$M_COUNT" "$A_COUNT" "$D_COUNT" "$D_LEAN" "$HEAD_MISSING" "$DISK_MISSING" "$DISK_MISSING_LEAN"'
